research_question: Can a learned invariant-base controller preserve solver-qualified hand raising at the first task-specific impulse severity that rejects the fixed base?
primary_endpoint: Qualified success requires every requested wrist COM to reach 0.88 m and rise 0.20 m, zero terminations and failed environment steps, minimum root height above 0.64 m, and maximum tilt below 0.50 rad.
claim_gates: all 30 task-method-seed cells complete from one clean revision
the fixed base fails at least one held-out run for every task
the learned invariant base qualifies all 15 held-out runs
all learned runs exactly replay from retained commands, policies, seeds, and fingerprints
simulator evidence is not hardware evidence
pilot_note: The pilot varied only push severity. The frozen severities are the first tested values that rejected the fixed base: 0.20 m/s for each unilateral command and 0.80 m/s for the shorter symmetric bilateral command.
